run_eval_word_vectors: run the eval script to compute Spearman correlation between predicted and gold word similarity scores
run_similarity_evaluation: run the evaluation tool with a model path and data file to measure word vector quality
test_similarity_function: test the similarity function that computes cosine similarity between two numpy vectors
test_compat_splitting: test the compat_splitting function that decodes UTF-8 bytes and splits a line into tokens
review_eval_script: review the eval script that loads word vectors and computes Spearman correlation on similarity data
